name: xo-rps-gitops-platform
description: Cloud-native GitOps CI/CD demo using Next.js, NestJS, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, and AWS EKS.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @xo-rps/api && npm run build -w @xo-rps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @xo-rps/api && npm run test -w @xo-rps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @xo-rps/api && npm run lint -w @xo-rps/web
